items.title: Bob Stewart interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: And Terence Blanchard just went through this some years ago... where he had to change his embouchure because he was having problems

ctx.x: Some music teacher along the way said I need a tuba player?

No. You know I played trumpet all the way through high school. I was good on trumpet. I had a scholarship to go to college, played trumpet through my first two years of college. And because of some teaching, early teaching that gave me some embouchure problems and I had to do a graduation recital in another two years, in actually a year and a half, and there was no way I would have been able to do it on trumpet so I went to a larger mouthpiece and that larger mouthpiece happened to be a tuba, and just trained new…
it’s very, very difficult, and I didn’t have time to do it in that amount of time so I switched to tuba and did a recital on tuba in about a year and a half. I hated it.
